description.value:
These protruding spikes give armor an aggressive appearance. When you take energy damage, the spikes become charged with that energy type until the next time they're Activated (even if the damage was completely prevented by resistance).

Activate—Impale f

Frequency once per round

Trigger Your turn begins

Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Grabbed], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Restrained], or swallowed by a creature or have a creature grabbed or restrained

Effect You deal @Damage[5d4[untyped]] damage to the required creature. This damage is piercing unless the spikes are charged with an energy type, in which case you can have them deal damage of that type instead.
